whyItMatters: php LDAP filters assemble from parts (ldap_searchs*([^)]*(?:"[^"n]*$|.s*$)), so input metacharacters rewrite the query.
actions: Escape every value with ldap_escape for filter values before interpolation.
Prefer parameterized directory calls where the library offers them.
Re-run the scan and confirm no raw interpolation remains.
verification: Rescan shows no raw filter interpolation, and metacharacter input matches literally.
